captions.ig:
Customers text at 9 PM. You do not have to answer at 9 PM.

1. One short auto reply: thanks, and when they will hear from you.
2. Ask for the one detail you need to price it, like a photo or the model.
3. Add one line for real emergencies.
4. Answer them all in one sitting in the morning. Only offer times you can keep.
5. Let Claude draft the batch. Prompt is on slide 6.

Sample business shown is made up.

Comment AGENTS and we will DM you the free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice. It drafts, you send.

Sources: Housecall Pro, Heymarket, Textline, Callingly, ShiftFlow.
